description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Serova is hiring a Founding Product Engineer to own its product end to end, from design through frontend and backend implementation. The role focuses on building patient- and clinician-facing products, rebuilding a scientific dashboard, and developing workflows and internal tools with cross-functional teams.
Founding Product Engineer building clinical data dashboards and workflow tools for patients, clinicians, and vaccine-design operations

Responsibilities:
• Build Serova's first patient- and clinician-facing product on top of internal data (antigen prediction, vaccine design, case status)
• Rebuild the scientific dashboard from scratch: UX, visual design, implementation
• Work with clinical, wet lab, manufacturing and engineering teams to design workflows
• Build internal tools/front-end services (data access, follow-ups, CRO/manufacturing processes) on one shared DB
• Lead new product surfaces concept-to-production (Postgres, Python, React/TypeScript)

Requirements:
• 1-6 yrs full-time engineering, owned a product end to end (FE+BE), ideally 0-1 at Seed-Series B
• Real product and design taste; ships without spec/designer/PM
• Track record of products non-engineers used

Preferred:
• design-engineer profile
• dense-data/scientific UIs
• founder or first-10 employee
